The '''1998 United States Senate election in Utah''' was held November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Bennett won re-election to a second term.

== Major candidates ==
=== Democratic ===
* Scott Leckman, physician<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://nl.newsbank.com/nl-search/we/Archives?p_product=NewsLibrary&p_multi=DSNB&d_place=DSNB&p_theme=newslibrary2&p_action=search&p_maxdocs=200&p_topdoc=1&p_text_direct-0=0F364B42005082A7&p_field_direct-0=document_id&p_perpage=10&p_sort=YMD_date:D&s_trackval=GooglePM|title=Cookies not enabled?}}</ref>

=== Republican ===
* [[Bob Bennett (politician)|Bob Bennett]], incumbent U.S. Senator
